stack_observations: Main thread mach_msg2_trap: before20251/20549 (98.55%), after27893/28447 (98.05%); sample fractions are not CPU percentages.
After: SwiftUI.prepare-image queue125 samples, including ImageIO/AppleJPEG decode71 samples; main _SwiftUIProxyImage finish126 samples waits for image preparation.

After: ReaderView.body getter4 inclusive samples, readerSurfaceBackground2; activeReaderBackgroundImage URL resolution1 and UIImage(contentsOfFile:)1. Does not establish invocation count or sustained repetition.
No CoreTextPageEngine, CommentBubble, or BookSourceSession frames in either sample. Firestore/gRPC and JSC background threads predominantly wait; no proven busy-loop stack.
GCAnalytics input poll timer before6/after10 samples. No evidence these small sampled callbacks explain prior6.47%.

Before/after exact sample wall windows contain no PID87765 application log entries; SourcePerf was not emitted for this diagnostic PID, so this absence is not an independently instrumented SourcePerf measurement.
